Mover.description: Someone on the moving firm's staff: crew, driver, packer or office. A first name alone is not an identity.

Client.description: A household or business whose belongings the firm moves.

CrewTie.description: How two movers stand on the crew: one is the other's foreman, or mentors the other.

Handling.description: Which mover looks after a client: the estimator surveys the home, the coordinator runs the move.

Move.description: One removal job for a client. booked_by took the booking, driver drives the van, packer packs; stage is quoted, scheduled, completed or cancelled.

Claim.description: A client's damage claim for one item. settled stays empty until a settlement is recorded.

questions.q: Who is Bogdan Petrescu's crew lead?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mover)-[:foreman]->(n1:Mover) WHERE n0.called = 'Bogdan Petrescu' RETURN n1.called AS called

questions.speaker: marisol
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mover)-[:mentor]->(n1:Mover) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.called AS called

questions.speaker: kofi

questions.speaker: marisol
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mover)-[:accounts]->(n1:Client) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Client)-[:coordinator]->(n1:Mover) WHERE n0.name = 'Dev Raghunathan' RETURN n1.called AS called

questions.q: Who was the surveyor for Dev Raghunathan?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Client)-[:estimator]->(n1:Mover) WHERE n0.name = 'Dev Raghunathan' RETURN n1.called AS called

questions.q: How many boxes does the piano job need?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Move) WHERE n0.job CONTAINS 'piano' RETURN n0.boxes AS boxes

questions.q: Which jobs did Marisol Quintero book?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mover)<-[:booked_by]-(n1:Move) WHERE n0.called = 'Marisol Quintero' RETURN n1.job AS job

questions.speaker: ilse
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mover)<-[:packer]-(n1:Move) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.job AS job

questions.q: Is there a record of insurance for the office clear-out?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Move) WHERE n0.job = 'office clear-out' RETURN coalesce(n0.insured, false) AS insured

questions.q: Was Noor Al-Saadi's studio move insured?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Client)<-[:client]-(n1:Move) WHERE n0.name = 'Noor Al-Saadi' AND n1.job CONTAINS 'studio' RETURN n1.insured AS insured

questions.q: Has Yusuf Demirci's claim been settled?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Client)<-[:client]-(n1:Claim) WHERE n0.name = 'Yusuf Demirci' RETURN n1.settled AS settled

questions.q: What item and amount does each claim name?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Claim) RETURN n0.item AS item, n0.amount_euros AS amount_euros

questions.q: What is Kofi Asamoah's phone number?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mover) WHERE n0.called = 'Kofi Asamoah' RETURN n0.phone AS phone

questions.q: Who drives the jobs for Harriet Lindqvist?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Client)<-[:client]-(n1:Move)-[:driver]->(n2:Mover) WHERE n0.name = 'Harriet Lindqvist' RETURN n2.called AS called
